feature.title: From reading a profile to sending a message.
feature.intro: Here’s what you’ll see when you open Histae, and what happens when you both want to talk.

profile.title: Something to start a conversation with
profile.text: Read their bio, answers and personality traits. You’ll see their name and age. Their photo stays hidden until you both want to share it. Before discovering others, a preview also lets you read your own profile as it will be presented.

preferences.title: Your preferences both matter
preferences.text: Age, who you are looking for and distance must work for both of you. For example, if your limit is 50 km and the other person’s is 20 km, you can only be suggested to each other within 20 km.

location.title: Location that is consensual and temporary
location.text: Both people need a recent location, with separate permission to use it. The distance shown is rounded; your exact location never appears on your profile. A location becomes stale after one hour and is deleted after 24 hours without an update. You can withdraw permission in the app.

discovery.title: What’s in your feed?
discovery.text: Compatible profiles are suggested in order of proximity. Blocks in either direction, saved likes or passes, and people you already have a recorded match with are excluded from suggestions.

stableDecisions.title: Seen that profile before?
stableDecisions.text: Likes and passes are kept for 30 days, so you do not have to make the same choice at each visit during that time. This does not guarantee a profile will return afterwards: compatibility rules still apply.

reciprocity.title: Your interest stays private
reciprocity.text: A single like doesn’t send a notification. You only match when the other person has chosen you too.

conversationWindow.title: A match, then a first hello
conversationWindow.text: You’ve each shown interest in the other’s profile. Messaging opens for 24 hours, with photos still hidden. Where you start is up to you.

continuationWindow.title: Another 24 hours to choose what comes next
continuationWindow.text: Sending pauses while history remains readable during the 24-hour decision window. The chat’s send action becomes the choice to continue, showing any applicable cost. A notification can tell you the other person would like to continue. Only both agreements reopen the conversation.

photoReveal.title: Decide about photos together
photoReveal.text: A photo is required to access the feed, but never appears there. Sharing within a match needs two agreements and is separate from continuation. Either person can withdraw consent, hiding both photos again. Replacing your photo updates it for matches where sharing is allowed.

messaging.title: Writing back
messaging.text: Messages can contain up to 2,000 characters. A discreet receipt marks your latest sent message and latest read message. Tap a message to see its date. You can keep writing while a message is being sent.

continuationCredits.title: A clear choice and credit cost
continuationCredits.text: Each Free member receives {freeCredits} credits per week and can continue up to {weeklyMaximum} conversations. A credit is only spent after both people agree. An optional video can add a credit, up to a stock of {advertisingStock} advertising credits. Your credits shows balances and the next renewal; Premium continues without spending credits.

pause.title: Take a break and keep your conversations
pause.text: Turn on pause mode in your profile to stop appearing in new suggestions and stop discovering new profiles. Your existing matches and conversations remain available. You can resume discovery whenever you feel ready.

reading.title: A profile you can take time to read
reading.text: A thin bar fills during the first three seconds of reading. Then double-tap to show interest, or swipe up at the end of the profile to move on. The Aa button adjusts text size and line spacing. A short guide introduces these gestures when you first reach the feed.

dailyUse.title: Find a conversation and pick it up again
dailyUse.text: Search your matches by first name and spot unread messages by their counter. Archived conversations have a separate entry point. In a chat, tapping the name reopens the profile, with a larger photo if you have both agreed to share.

drafts.title: Your message can wait
drafts.text: You can recover an unsent message or unfinished profile answer on the same device after closing the app. These drafts stay on your phone and are erased when you sign out. Biographies are not saved this way.

notifications.title: Alerts while you are away
notifications.text: With notifications allowed, alerts keep you informed about exchanges, continuation choices and shared photos. Match alerts include the other person’s first name without the text of their messages. While the app is open, conversations update directly.

security.title: Security
security.intro: Histae makes room for what you have to say. It also gives you practical choices about what you share, who can contact you and how you manage your data.

promise.title: Give the conversation a chance
promise.text: A photo doesn’t tell you what makes someone laugh, what fascinates them or how they listen. A bio and a few messages can tell you a little more.

passwordless.title: Passwordless access
passwordless.text: A code sent by SMS lets you sign in without a password to remember. Attempts are limited. My sessions lets you review access and revoke sessions you do not recognise.

consents.title: A separate choice for each use
consents.text: Accepting the terms, reading the privacy notice, allowing sensitive data and sharing your location are separate steps. Advertising preferences are managed separately too: continuing a match does not agree to ad tracking.

consentWithdrawal.title: You can withdraw permission
consentWithdrawal.text: Withdrawing location permission deletes the stored position. Withdrawing sensitive-data consent removes the relevant gender and preferences. Some features, including profile suggestions, can no longer work afterwards.

rights.title: Get a copy or delete your data
rights.text: You can export your data or request account deletion in the app. Need to correct something you cannot edit yourself? Describe the correction in My requests and follow the reply. Consent choices, blocked people and sessions have their own controls.

download.title: Android testing has started.
download.intro: Histae is being tested on Android by invited testers only. There is no announced date for a public launch yet.

android.label: Android
android.text: The app is currently being tested through Google Play. Access remains limited to invited testers, including through the link below.
android.access: Open the listing with the Google account associated with your invitation. The link alone does not grant access to the test.

ios.label: iPhone
ios.text: No iOS test or App Store link has been announced yet. This page will be updated when access opens.

download.footerNote: Histae is for people aged 18 and over. Registration currently supports French +33 phone numbers.
